feature: Prompt engineering to reach D1/D2/D3 acceptance gates
problem: After removing buggy/fix label leakage, the agent fails 3/6 dimension gates: D1=0.40 (gate 0.70), D2=0.08 (gate 0.15), D3=0.13 (gate 0.20). The agent reads diffs correctly (D6=0.85) and calibrates severity well (D4=0.84), but under-classifies buggy commits as MEDIUM and produces generic reasoning that misses root causes.
proposed_solution: Three low-effort, high-impact prompt changes: (1) Add explicit risk classification rubric mapping code patterns to risk levels, (2) Inject XGBoost router probability as calibrated prior context, (3) Add 2-3 few-shot investigation examples showing good root-cause analysis. Validate with n=20 stratified eval.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: System prompt includes a risk classification rubric with concrete pattern→risk mappings (e.g., API contract changes→HIGH, test-only changes→LOW)
AC-2: XGBoost router probability is passed to the agent as context (NOT the buggy label — oracle isolation preserved)
AC-3: System prompt includes 2-3 few-shot examples of high-quality investigation reports with specific root-cause reasoning
AC-4: Oracle isolation tests pass (76+ tests, no regressions) — router probability is NOT a ground truth leak
AC-5: n=20 stratified eval (10 buggy, 10 clean) shows D1 >= 0.60 (improvement from 0.40, trending toward gate 0.70)
AC-6: n=20 eval shows D3 >= 0.18 (improvement from 0.13, trending toward gate 0.20)
AC-7: D6 >= 0.70 (no regression on evidence grounding from prompt changes)
AC-8: D4 >= 0.50 (no regression on severity calibration)
AC-9: Per-commit eval JSONs in evaluations/ folder confirm agent no longer references buggy/fix labels in reasoning_summary
AC-10: docs/evaluation.md updated with n=20 post-prompt results and comparison to pre-prompt baseline
edge_cases: EC-1: Agent with router_probability=0.95 (near HIGH threshold) should not blindly say HIGH — must still reason from diff evidence
EC-2: Few-shot examples don't cause the agent to parrot example language — reasoning must reference actual commit content
EC-3: Commits with truncated diffs (>4K chars) should not systematically score lower on D1 than full-diff commits
verification_method: Run n=20 stratified eval with post-prompt agent. Compare D1/D2/D3/D6 against pre-prompt baseline (n=5 clean run). Check oracle isolation tests. Read 3 random eval reports to verify reasoning quality.
